name: MTA Daily Ridership and Traffic: Beginning 2020
description: The daily ridership dataset provides systemwide ridership and traffic estimates for subways (including the Staten Island Railway), buses, Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North Railroad, Access-A-Ride, Bridges and Tunnels, and the Central Business District and Congestion Relief Zone since the start of Congestion Pricing

Dataset Summary.Organization: New York City Transit, MTA Bus Company, Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North Railroad, Access-A-Ride, MTA Bridges and Tunnels, Staten Island Railway

Notes.Notes: Due to the processes followed to allow next-day ridership and traffic figures to be published, the figures in this dataset may differ from official ridership totals published elsewhere by MTA.

columns.name: Count
columns.description: The daily total estimated ridership or traffic
